reference.access: Bootlin endpoint blocked by robots in this session; compare source paths and pin exact revision before patching

gaps.evidence: kernel/arch/targets.json marks AArch64/RV64 as port-layer and R8192/C8192 as emulator
gaps.acceptance: Per-architecture build+boot+userspace evidence; status never inferred across architectures

gaps.evidence: kernel/build-koronos.sh assembles x86_64 NASM sources; AArch64/RV64 have stubs but are not linked by this builder
gaps.acceptance: Correct boot protocol, firmware data, stack, CPU/hart identity, first console for each architecture

gaps.evidence: ELF admission/load-plan is not proof of process execution
gaps.acceptance: PT_LOAD/BSS, permissions, user stack, isolated page tables and real production init

gaps.evidence: kernel/core/syscall.cpp handles GETPID/YIELD/TIME_TICKS/EXIT semantics only; GETPID returns constant 1; EXIT does not prove teardown
gaps.acceptance: Real PID allocation, safe user-copy, errno ABI, process exit/reap/wait and tested advertised syscall set

gaps.evidence: Scheduler CPU indices/shared task table do not prove hardware AP/hart startup or concurrent execution
gaps.acceptance: AP/hart online logs, concurrent work, timer preemption, IPI/cross-CPU wakeups, affinity and lock stress

gaps.evidence: Yield is not proof of timer preemption or architecture-correct user return
gaps.acceptance: Exception/syscall frame round trips and timer-driven preemption/sleep-wakeup tests per architecture

gaps.evidence: Distinct Live/Installer/Recovery payloads must match compression/archive/parser/module contracts
gaps.acceptance: Extract actual ISO; verify hashes, compression, archive, module names, ELF machine and actual selected init

gaps.evidence: Ring-3 smoke ELF/kernel message does not prove VFS, service manager, shell, installer, recovery or desktop
gaps.acceptance: Real target init starts required services and emits canonical readiness only after startup

gaps.evidence: Artwork staging is not display-driver or device initialization evidence
gaps.acceptance: Reliable serial/debug console, graphics fallback and enumerated device-driver results

gaps.evidence: Feature registry entries do not prove safe feature detection or native RegisterN ISA
gaps.acceptance: Feature-gated execution, topology report and explicit emulator/native distinction

policy: fail-closed; NOT RUN/NOT IMPLEMENTED is not PASS; no release promotion until production target evidence exists
